## Checklist

- [ ] `node tools/validate.mjs` passes
- [ ] Judgment, not steps: it says what the best builder notices first, the common mistake, and what good output looks like
- [ ] `SKILL.md` and `references/` name no vendor or platform. Platform detail is in an optional layer file
- [ ] Every bulk, destructive, money or outbound-message step has a human approval
- [ ] No secrets, no hidden endpoints, nothing that asks a user for credentials
- [ ] `author` and `authorUrl` point to a real person and their own profile
